caption:
ADHD in adults is not always the restless kid at the back of the class.

Research suggests women, high achievers and people with mainly inattentive ADHD are more likely to be recognised late. Quieter traits draw less attention, and strong coping strategies can cover difficulties until life's demands outgrow them. Australian guidelines say ADHD should be considered at any age, and that it does not always look like the stereotype.

Part of our series, ADHD: the full picture.

Research:
Attoe, D. E., & Climie, E. A. (2023). Miss. diagnosis: A systematic review of ADHD in adult women. https://doi.org/10.1177/10870547231161533
Australian ADHD Professionals Association. (2022). Australian evidence-based clinical practice guideline for ADHD. https://adhdguideline.aadpa.com.au/
